description:
We're an undergraduate team of:

- 1 4th year CS, 4 hackathons, strong with fullstack/frontend webdev & project management/SDLC

- 1 1st year CS, beginner, 1st hackathon

- 1 2nd year EE, 2 - 3 hackathons, strong in physics, math (up to calc 2 or 3), & circuits/hardware

- 1 3rd year Physics, 1st hackathon, strong in astrophysics & math

We need: data science/analysis/visualization, map/GIS/geospatial, 2d/3d graphics/animation (game-design), Python AND/OR backend/database skills
